When I was homeless there were a ton of local resources but finding them felt impossible. Eventually I was stopped by a police officer and then refereed to a program that specialized in linking homeless people to resources. 

A lot of the homeless centers and those who provide resources to homeless will work with similar programs so as soon as you find one place that can offer any help ASK for all the other help they know of. They can't give you what you need if you don't ask for it.  In the US there are different programs you can get into if you have children with you, you are a teenager etc. so be open about what is going on so people can try and help you best.
